_metadata.description: Brand CRUD + versioning, persisted in the single SQLite (WAL) brand-manager database. The authoring core every other domain reads from.

requirements.title: Create, read, update, and delete brands with full identity payload
requirements.description: The API supports create/read/update/delete of a brand carrying identity (display name, slug, notes), visuals (logo/favicon/icon refs), colors, typography, and voice, exposed over Connect-RPC and surfaced through the CLI.

validation.notes: Planned unit coverage at api/internal/brands/service_test.go once the brands domain is ported.

requirements.title: Each brand mutation produces an immutable brand version
requirements.description: Updating a brand appends an immutable brand_versions row capturing the full prior snapshot, so any historical version can be read back and re-applied without data loss.

validation.notes: Planned unit coverage at api/internal/brands/versions_test.go once versioning is ported.

requirements.title: Mutations enforce optimistic concurrency and idempotency
requirements.description: Update/delete reject a stale expected-version with a conflict error, and a repeated mutation carrying the same idempotency key returns the original result rather than applying twice.

validation.notes: Planned unit coverage at api/internal/brands/concurrency_test.go once concurrency control is ported.

requirements.title: Brands persist in a single SQLite (WAL) database that survives restart
requirements.description: Brands, brand_versions, and assignments are stored in a single WAL-mode SQLite database at ~/.vrooli/brand-manager/brand-manager.db, and records survive an API process restart.

validation.notes: Planned unit coverage at api/internal/repository/sqlite_test.go once the SQLite repository is ported.
